item.text: The hang comes from worker threads unwinding independently while other workers keep waiting for work. I’m adding shared panic capture plus a shutdown flag, then rethrowing the original payload after all scoped workers have joined.

item.text: The first regression run exposed a second wait path: workers already sleeping inside their polling loop never rechecked the shared quit flag. I’m fixing that polling loop so a panic wakes every worker even when no quit message was queued.
